title: Evidence-driven Adaptive Assessment Planner: scores runners using signal evidence and runner metadata, produces run/skip/wait/approval plan with reasoning — no more serial 20-tool batteries
goal: Replace the current fixed Phase 2 tool battery (run all 20 runners always) with an evidence-driven planner that reads the SignalProfile from backlog-256 and the RunnerCapabilityMetadata from backlog-258, then produces a scored assessment plan: for each available runner, one of: RUN (evidence supports it, confidence >= 0.7), SKIP (evidence contradicts it, reason shown), WAIT (insufficient evidence yet, needs more recon), NEEDS_APPROVAL (intrusive tier, requires explicit gate). The planner does NOT autonomously execute tools — it produces a recommended plan that the operator reviews and approves. Implementation: (1) Create api/app/services/assessment_planner.py that takes SignalProfile + RunnerCapabilityMetadata and produces AssessmentPlan: { runners: [ { runner: 'xss-extended', decision: 'RUN', confidence: 0.90, reasons: ['file_upload_endpoint found at /upload', 'login_form found at /wp-login.php'], estimated_minutes: 12 }, { runner: 'jwt-probe', decision: 'SKIP', confidence: 0.05, reasons: ['jwt_in_response: false', 'no Authorization Bearer header seen'] }, { runner: 'sqlmap', decision: 'WAIT', confidence: 0.35, reasons: ['PHP+MySQL detected but no injectable_parameter or sql_error_pattern signal found — needs spider evidence first'] }, { runner: 'deserialization-probe', decision: 'SKIP', confidence: 0.08, reasons: ['java_indicators: false', 'no JSESSIONID cookie'] } ] }. (2) Show the AssessmentPlan in Mission Control BEFORE Phase 2 launches: three columns — RUN (green, checked by default), WAIT (amber, unchecked), SKIP (grey, unchecked with reason). Operator can move items between columns. (3) Clicking 'Launch Assessment' creates Phase 2 tasks only for RUN items. AI explains each decision in one sentence. Note: the planner SELECTS from existing approved runners — it does not create new tools or bypass approval gates. Intrusive runners always require the explicit approval gate regardless of plan.
scope: ChatGPT review 2026-05-06 confirmed this architecture. Current approach runs 20 tools serially. sqlmap should only trigger on concrete parameter/form/error evidence, not on PHP+MySQL alone. The planner needs runner metadata to know prerequisites and triggers. This is the evidence-driven approach that makes AegisPT behave like an expert pentester.
generation_reason: Evidence-driven tool selection: stop running all 20 tools always. Planner reads signals, scores runners by evidence match, shows operator 7 selected / 11 skipped / 5 waiting plan.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: REQUIRES: backlog-256 (SignalProfile) and backlog-258 (RunnerCapabilityMetadata) must be completed first — the planner reads both.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Planner SELECTS from existing runners only. Does not create tools, bypass gates, or auto-dispatch. Intrusive runners always require approval regardless of plan score.

success_criteria: AssessmentPlan produced after recon phase with RUN/SKIP/WAIT/NEEDS_APPROVAL decision per runner.
Each decision includes reasoning in plain language (one sentence).
sqlmap decision = WAIT when no injectable_parameter or sql_error_pattern signal (PHP+MySQL alone insufficient).
jwt-probe decision = SKIP when jwt_in_response: false.
Mission Control shows three-column plan UI: RUN (green) / WAIT (amber) / SKIP (grey).
Operator can move runners between columns before launching.
Only RUN column items are dispatched when operator approves.
Intrusive runners always show NEEDS_APPROVAL regardless of evidence score.
Audit log records which runners were planned/skipped and why.
No regression in existing chain or assessment tests.

acceptance_criteria: AssessmentPlan renders in Mission Control after recon.
sqlmap WAIT when no parameter evidence.
jwt-probe SKIP when no JWT signals.
